assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are the maintainers' provisional rough ranges (provisional_constraint); they are used for AI generation, self-check and display only.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated when official polygons replace the provisional ones; content scoring is not blocked by the organiser's geometry gap.

assumptions.statement: Land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing and AI inn nodes are concept suggestions generated by the AI agent to illustrate spatial structure and scenario organisation.
assumptions.impact: No statutory planning, engineering, ownership, investment or implementation conclusion is implied; professional teams may deepen or replace any layer.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, test scenarios, annual events and operation mechanisms are concept proposals, not approved operations or confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Privacy and human-review boundaries apply to every AI scenario; deployment claims remain pending feasibility and approval procedures.

assumptions.statement: Global AI ecosystem case references are limited to publicly verifiable information; no company lists, investment amounts, output values or fiscal commitments are asserted.
assumptions.impact: Case study tables remain methodological references and must not be read as verified industrial facts.
